€2P. [उप-इ] 
__1 To approach, come near, arrive at, reach (a place, person &c.); परमं साभ्यमुपैति [[Muṇḍ. 3. 1. 3.]] लतामुपेत्य [[Ś. 1]]; so राजानम्, दुर्गम् &c. योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् [[Bg. 8. 28]], 10. 15, 9. 28. 
__2 To go to (a master), become a pupil. उपेत्य पप्रच्छ [[Praśna. Up. 1. 2]]; 6. 1. 
__3 To have intercourse with (a woman), cohabit; वाच्यश्चानुपयन् पतिः [[Ms. 9. 4.]] 
__4 To under go, perform, undertake, practise; तपः, सत्रम् &c. 
__5 To go to or pass into any state; योगम् [[R. 16. 84]]; भेदम् [[Ku. 2. 4]]; to fall into (misfortune &c.); क्षयम्, मत्युम्, सुखम्, दुःखम्, निद्राम् &c. 
__6 To obtain, attain to; तस्य प्रिया ज्ञातयः सुकृतमुपयन्ति [[Kauṣ. Up. 1. 1]]; उपैति शस्यं परिणामरम्यताम् [[Ki. 4. 22.]] 
__7 To incur, be present at. 
__8 To fall to one's lot or share, befall; उद्योगिनं पुरुषसिंहमुपैति लक्ष्मीः [[Pt. 1. 361]]; [[Bg. 6. 27.]] 
__9 To consider as, admit, acknowledge.

p. p. 
__1 Come near, approached, arrived at; लोकाश्च वो मयोपेता देवा अप्यनुमन्वते [[Bhāg. 10. 23. 32.]] 
__2 Present. 
__3 Endowed with, possessed of, having; with instr. or in comp.; पुत्रमेवंगुणोपेतं चकवर्तिनमाप्नुहि [[Ś. 1. 12.]] 
__4 Blockaded. 
__5 Fallen into. 
__6 Approached for sexual gratification.

a. 
__1 Approaching near to. 
__2 Contriving, one who uses expedients; [[Ms. 7. 215.]]

pot. p. 
__1 To be gone to or approached. 
__2 To be effected by means; °उपायदर्शने [[M. 1.]] 
__3 Assailable. 
__4 To be sought; [[Ms. 7. 215.]] 
__5 To be obtained. 
__6 To be approached sexually; 
-यः A thing to be obtained; अबरः श्रद्धयोपेत उपेयान्विन्दतेऽञ्जसा [[Bhāg. 4. 18. 4.]]
a. (उप इण् क्वसु [[P. III. 2. 109]]) One who has gone near उपेयिवांसि कर्तारः पुरीमाजातशात्रवीम् [[Śi. 2. 114.]]

__1 Ā. 1 To neglect, overlook, disregard, connive at; किमात्मनिर्वादकथामुपेक्षे [[R. 14. 34]]; उपेक्षते यः श्लथलम्बिनीर्जटाः [[Ku. 5. 47.]] 
__2 To let escape or let go; नोपेक्षेत क्षणमपि राजा साहासिकं नरम् [[Ms. 8. 344.]] 
__3 To quit, abandon. 
__4 To despise, slight. 
__5 To notice, consider, have regard to; एवमुच्चावचानर्थान् प्राहुः ते उपेक्षितव्याः [[Nir.]] 
__6 To look at, regard, perceive; प्रासादस्था हपुपैक्षत [[Nala. 22. 5.]]
a. To be overlooked, disregarded; object of indifference

__1 Overlooking, disregard, neglect. 
__2 Indifference, contempt, disdain; कुर्यामुपेक्षां हतजीवितेऽस्मिन् [[R. 14. 65.]] 
__3 Leaving, quitting. 
__4 Endurance, patience. 
__5 Dissent. 
__6 Neglect, trick or deceit (one of the 7 expedients in war). 
__7 A sort of भावना in Yoga, q. v. 
__8 Regard, consideration.
Den. P. (उप-एडक) To behave as a sheep towards; [[Kāśi.]] on Pāṇini VI. 1. 94.
a. Driven or pressed in. [[Śat. Br.]]

[उपगत इन्द्रं अनुजत्वात्] N. of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa as the younger brother of Indra in his 5th or dwarf incarnation; see इन्द्र; उपेन्द्रवज्रादपि दारुणोऽसि [[Gīt. 5]]; यदुपेन्द्रस्त्बमतीन्द्र एव सः [[Śi. 16. 70.]] 
-Comp. 
-वज्रा f. N. of a metre; see App. 
-अपत्यम् Madana, God of love … उद्भटोपेन्द्रापत्यपराकमैकनिधयो भद्राणि संतन्बते [[Chola-Champū. P. 27]], verse 61.
